thread:
morgan: quick async roundup — what I did / blockers / today

morgan: what I did: rolled routing-policy v2 into staging (PR #4123), updated route table for api/* -> gw-cluster-b, added a small egress rule for auth calls.
morgan: blocker: seeing a p95 latency bump on POST /v1/generate in staging after the policy change; looks like short bursts queueing into a single worker. traces attached in logs.
morgan: today: will investigate batching thresholds and KV-cache reuse, and open a small rollback if needed. can someone sanity-check the policy diff? particularly the rate window math.

isha: looking now. I pulled the traces, agree there's a burst pattern at 00:17:xx UTC where many POSTs land in same shard.
isha: quick question — did we change the routeKey hashing? if so might explain shard hotness.
isha: i'll take code review on #4123 after lunch.

paul: I pushed a probe to simulate 50 RPS bursts to staging env, reproduced the queueing. results: p95 ~ 420ms (baseline 180ms).
paul: temp mitigation: lowered max-batch-size to 8 in the gw worker config and it brought p95 to ~230ms. not a long-term fix, but helpful to confirm batching is the lever.

ana: @morgan re: auth — did the token rotation patch land in the same deploy? might increase auth latency for cold connections.

morgan: @ana good call — token rotation gate was on but only for dedicated tenants. the config flip was accidental; will revert that back to previous behavior.

liam: pinging infra — can you check node affinity for gw-cluster-b? if shards are pinned to fewer instances that'd amplify bursts.

deploy-bot: deploy status: staging/gw-cluster-b updated at 2026-03-17T09:12:21Z by morgan (PR #4123). health: degraded -> degraded (investigating).

isha: next steps for me: review #4123 by 13:00 PT, run partitioned probe with heat-map on routeKey to confirm hashing effect.

paul: i'll make a follow-up PR to expose batch size as an env override per pool so we can experiment without redeploying code.

morgan: blocker summary: route hashing + unexpected token-rotation flag. owner: morgan/isha. mitigation: lower batch size + revert token flag.

morgan: asks: if anyone can spare 30m this afternoon for quick pairing to validate a replay test (simulate burst -> watch KV cache reuse) — @paul @ana @liam?

ana: I can join 15:30 PT.

liam: 15:30 PT works for me.

paul: should be able to join for first 20.

morgan: awesome — I'll drop a Zoom and post link shortly. also leaving a short checklist in #4123 explaining how to reproduce locally with the probe script:

morgan: ```bash
# repro script (local)
python tools/probes/burst_probe.py --rate 50 --duration 60 --endpoint https://staging-internal.redwood/api/v1/generate 
```

morgan: thanks folks :thumbsup:

isha: noted, will add heatmap outputs to the PR.

paul: and i'll open the batch-size override PR after pairing so we can iterate quickly.

deploy-bot: uptime check scheduled at 2026-03-17T09:45:00Z for staging/gw-cluster-b.
